item.title: Comment on Enrollment In Health-Sharing Ministries Skyrockets by Richard Remmele
item.description: I have been selling health insurance for over 20 years and this was popular once before and many couldn't keep up with claims and went bankrupt without paying and one that I know of had taken the money and the leaders were prosecuted. With regular health insurance there is state backing for non paid claims and the states monitor the reserve for claims. No protection for these health-sharing ministries.

item.title: Comment on A More Balanced Approach to Comparing Policy Illustrations by Byron Udell
item.description: "Illustrations" have been, and will continue to be, a lousy way of "comparing" life insurance policies. Why? item.title: Comment on Employees Turn Away From High-Deductible Health Plans: Report by Judy AP
item.description: People will just get very sick. As 2 diabetics that need medicine. My husband's company gave us a $5G deductible. No coverage for Dr. or Prescription drug. Medicine cost are averaging over $1G a mo and no testing supplies are covered. We see $700 a mo. leave the paycheck for virtually no coverage.
